description: Package a custom backend service process alongside the user interface bundle to handle server-side request processing.

change_context.other_context: Determine whether the edge runtime can spawn or execute an application-provided daemon to serve dynamic backend responses directly.

human_notes: Single: Constraint limiting hosted apps to static frontend bundles without app-provided server execution (ref-helix-001) governs requests for custom server-side backend processes.

description: Record anonymous survey responses from web clients where submissions can be written but must not be queryable by client sessions.

change_context.other_context: Persist incoming survey submissions into storage while ensuring client sessions cannot inspect or retrieve previously submitted survey items.

human_notes: Single: Three-scope storage model defining collection scope as write-only without read access for client runtimes (ref-helix-002) governs asymmetric survey intake.

description: Activate a previously validated preview build as the production release and restore an earlier release if regressions occur.

change_context.other_context: Switch the active production release to an existing deployed build artifact and revert to a prior target version when needed.

human_notes: Single: Versioning model with preview-default deployment, pointer promotion, and rollback to prior immutable versions (ref-helix-003) governs release switching.

description: Expose runtime services to the browser client using the application's domain path instead of configuring external host endpoints.

change_context.other_context: Connect client-side interactions to platform capabilities while avoiding cross-domain request headers or separate origin configuration.

human_notes: Single: Co-located gateway exposed on the application origin without cross-origin configuration (ref-helix-004) governs routing frontend capability calls.

description: Update an application specification to grant outbound network access to an unlisted third-party API domain.

change_context.other_context: Process declarative permission updates when an application expands its allowed remote destination boundaries.

human_notes: Single: Requirement to evaluate capability changes and route privilege escalations to administrative review (ref-helix-009) governs expanding outbound origins.

description: Update the edge-side chat request path to support a newly configured model provider so client requests can authenticate successfully with upstream services.

change_context.other_context: Adjust edge server initialization and provider routing so chat completion requests dispatch to the provider endpoint without failing authentication.

human_notes: Single: Architecture directing model requests through an egress boundary so edge servers hold no upstream API credentials (ref-helix-010) governs provider dispatch.

description: Evaluate a proposal for connecting applications to external source repositories and ingesting deployable build output produced outside the platform.

change_context.other_context: Assess architectural tradeoffs in the design document for linking external repositories to applications and receiving release artifacts.

human_notes: Single: Proposed pull-only architecture consuming prebuilt attested artifacts from external CI (ref-helix-012) governs evaluating repository-linked application intake.

description: Prevent authenticated portal callers from accessing or modifying stored credentials belonging to applications they do not manage.

change_context.other_context: An authenticated user can currently invoke credential management endpoints for other applications; add the missing route-level authorization check.

human_notes: Single: Operative owner-or-admin authorization guard restricting mutating and sensitive read routes on portal endpoints (ref-helix-014) governs securing management routes.

description: Allow public visitors without an active login session to post entries to a shared application guestbook.

change_context.other_context: Handle incoming public requests updating common application data keys without requiring user authentication headers.

human_notes: Single: Policy allowing unauthenticated writes to shared data keys on public apps within daily write limits (ref-helix-016) governs guestbook posts.

description: Prevent outbound proxy requests from connecting to internal network endpoints when processing target URLs provided by client applications.

change_context.other_context: A client-supplied outbound target can resolve to a local, private, or cloud metadata endpoint and must be rejected before the proxy connects.

human_notes: Single: Destination address validation and connection hardening rules for egress proxy requests (ref-helix-018) govern outbound safety checks.
